title: Document or pin capacity-before-authority order on relay and mailbox admission
outcome: The relay and mailbox admission order is either stated in the code comment and the feature doc, or pinned by a test: a replay-refused counter gets the 503 UNKNOWN first; then the per-peer permit, so at full capacity a fresh request gets the 429 RpcCapacity even when authority would refuse it as stale, not-current or a header mismatch; then authority. The MAC is verified before any of these, and the prompt-policy path uses the same order.
acceptance: Document or pin capacity-before-authority order on relay and mailbox admission is done
